Earlier, multiple backend code changes indicated that Apple was adding Car Keys support for Tank brand vehicles under Great Wall Motors (GWM); it now appears Apple is preparing to extend this functionality to another brand under the same automaker. Details below.

The Car Keys feature in Apple Wallet is reportedly set to support Haval vehicles

Several weeks ago, Apple added related code references in the backend, showing that Tank brand vehicles under Great Wall Motors would soon support the Car Keys feature in Apple Wallet. This feature allows users to lock, unlock, and start compatible vehicles using an iPhone or Apple Watch.

Now, according to a discovery by Aaron Perris on X, similar code references have also appeared for Haval—another brand under the same Chinese automaker:

Although some Haval models under Great Wall Motors already offer CarPlay, none currently support Apple's standalone Car Keys feature.

Once the feature officially launches, compatible Haval models will join the ranks of more than 50 models that currently support Car Keys, from brands including BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Hyundai, Kia, Genesis, Toyota, and Rivian.

Click here for more information about the Car Keys feature in Apple Wallet and to view the full list of compatible vehicles.
